dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Interconnected network of light-intensity polygonal and semi-circular 'C' shaped perimeters; edges exhibit sharp, high-contrast transitions from dark grey dorsal background to pale interior lineation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of clustered, pale-intensity pixels forming a reticulated lattice; highest concentrations are localized at the intersection points of the geometric cell structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest lateral annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle relative to the subject's midline; a secondary quadrangular pattern is formed by the centroids of the posterior-most visible cells.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A primary circular, crater-like lesion with reddish-pink interior pigmentation and a dark high-contrast outer ring located on the mid-lateral flank; secondary healed circular depression visible further posterior.
